ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: went down and got up harder
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been harder to frighten since going down in {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: went down and was shaken
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: Going down in {LABEL} left {PAWN_nameDef} flinching at sudden noises.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: held the line
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has carried {PAWN_objective}self taller since holding the line in {LABEL}.

plain.li: The others keep telling me I held the line in {LABEL}. I only remember the noise, and not wanting to move.
I didn't run in {LABEL}. I thought I might, right up until I didn't.
Two of them went down to me in {LABEL}, maybe more. I keep counting.
[persona:humble] They say I was the one who held in {LABEL}. Anyone would have, standing where I stood.

warm.li: I held my ground in {LABEL} because the people behind me were worth it. I'd do it again tomorrow.

blunt.li: They came at the line in {LABEL}. I didn't let them through.

cheerful.li: I held the line in {LABEL}, and I'm going to be unbearable about it for at least a week.

gloomy.li: I held in {LABEL}. It only means they'll expect me to hold next time too.

cold.li: The position held in {LABEL} because I held it. The arithmetic was simple.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: fought through a costly fight
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has held on to the living more tightly since {LABEL}, which not all of them survived.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: broke under fire
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has gone quiet whenever talk turns to fighting since breaking down during {LABEL}.

plain.li: I fell apart in {LABEL}, with the others still fighting. I don't know how to look at them now.
In the middle of {LABEL} something in me gave way. The others had to manage without me.
I keep going back over {LABEL}, to the moment I stopped being any use.

warm.li: Not one person has said a hard word to me about {LABEL}. That almost makes it worse.

blunt.li: I broke during {LABEL}. That's the truth of it.

gloomy.li: So now everyone knows what I'm like when it counts. I showed them in {LABEL}.

cold.li: My nerve failed in {LABEL}. A weakness, noted. I'll have to account for it.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: carried to safety
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: Since {OTHER} carried {PAWN_objective} to safety in {LABEL}, {PAWN_nameDef} has trusted people more readily.

plain.li: I was on the ground in {LABEL}, and then {OTHER_nameDef} was there, dragging me out. I owe {OTHER_objective} everything after that.
{OTHER_nameDef} came back for me in {LABEL}. I keep thinking about the fact that {OTHER_pronoun} didn't have to.
The last thing I remember of {LABEL} is {OTHER_nameDef}'s hands under my arms.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} carried me out of {LABEL}. I've told {OTHER_objective} thank you three times and it isn't nearly enough.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} pulled me out of {LABEL}. I owe {OTHER_objective}.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} hauled me out of {LABEL} like a sack of grain. Best sack of grain I've ever been!

gloomy.li: I'd be dead after {LABEL} if {OTHER_nameDef} hadn't come for me. I'm still deciding how I feel about that.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} took a risk to recover me in {LABEL}. A debt. I pay my debts.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: carried someone to safety
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has stood straighter since carrying {OTHER} to safety in {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: taken prisoner
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has watched every locked door since being taken prisoner.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: hardened by the raids
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has grown harder, and colder, through {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: worn down by the raids
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has looked tired to the bone, worn down by {LABEL}.

ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.label: swore vengeance
ColonyCouncil.PersonaMarkDef.shaped: {PAWN_nameDef} has been quicker to anger since swearing vengeance on {LABEL} for {OTHER}.
